purpose: Primary natural-language retrieval benchmark for B0-B3 model selection and one-shot confirmatory evaluation.

source.selection_note: Phase 3 query selection uses only the already-pinned BANKING77 source train after the frozen Phase 1 quarantine and validation assignment. The official BANKING77 test URL is not accessed by this benchmark materializer.

selection.feasibility_note: The first pre-scoring materialization attempt showed that the smallest frozen fit_train intent has 27 rows. The balanced allocation was therefore reduced from 20+10 to 18+8 before any retrieval score or hash freeze, leaving at least one unused row per intent.

evaluation.confirmatory_open_policy: Open once after B0-B3 selection, configuration freeze, and pre-confirmatory audit.

hash_manifest.note: No B0-B3 retrieval score may be produced until the deterministic materializer output is audited and these hashes are frozen.
